solutions.title: Linear square scan
solutions.strategy: Increase the candidate root until the next square would exceed x.

timeComplexity.explanation: The loop increments once for each possible integer root up to the answer.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the candidate root is stored.

solutions.title: Binary search root
solutions.strategy: Binary search the largest candidate whose square does not exceed x.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each comparison halves the candidate root range.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only boundaries, midpoint, and answer are maintained.
